summary: Wrong kind of design. Delivered a plain flat-lidded box around an untilted LCD: no 30 degree slope, no sloped panel, no window, no Pico 2, no standoffs for it and no USB opening. Gates G2, G4 and G5 fail. Score is an estimate.

defects.where: layout.json and the whole closed case; lid.stl top face Z 18.1 (flat); model_iso.png
defects.what: Display is not tilted and the panel is flat and horizontal
defects.expected: VIEW_AXIS 30 +-0.5 degrees from +Z, panel normal within 1 degree of VIEW_AXIS
defects.observed: 0 degrees; LCD standoffs vertical at Z -5.5 to 0, lid plate Z 15.7-18.1

defects.what: No window: ray casts at X 20, 40, 60 pass through 2 faces of a solid plate (Z 15.7 and 18.1)
defects.expected: through opening 65.5-68.0 x 15.0-18.0 over the viewport; view zone clear
defects.observed: none; the plate is solid and covers V-VIEW

defects.what: Pico 2 is not placed ("rpi_pico2 not a carrier: no relation places it") and no Pico standoffs exist
No Pico, so Pico-to-LCD-back clearance is unverified

defects.where: base.stl back wall (+Y), Y 36.6-39.0 at X 30
defects.what: No USB opening; the back wall is solid (also no wall opening anywhere)
defects.expected: one opening >= 11.6 x 8.6 around the USB mouth, plug d >= 0.3

defects.what: Standoff axes along Z, not VIEW_AXIS
defects.expected: axis within 1 degree of VIEW_AXIS (30 degrees from Z)

defects.what: Four lid bosses instead of the two at the rear corners; boss OD 5.6 < 6.0
Panel is a flat horizontal plate 2.4 thick, no window of any size or centring
Pico missing so USB axis, stacking overlap (>= 100 mm2) and unlisted-opening checks cannot hold
